title: Search params must be threaded through all prompt search layers together
answers: add a search option to mlflow.genai.search_prompts end to end
which layers need changes when adding order_by to prompt search
search_prompts parameter exists in store but not in genai API
body:
Invariant: prompt search has four layers that must expose the same parameters: RegistryClient.search_prompts / AbstractStore.search_prompts (store), MlflowClient.search_prompts (tracking client), _model_registry.fluent.search_prompts (shared fluent path behind mlflow.search_prompts and mlflow.genai.search_prompts), and mlflow.genai.prompts.search_prompts.
The store layer already accepted order_by; the three layers above it did not, so the feature was unreachable from user-facing APIs until all three were updated.
When adding a search option, update all four signatures and their docstrings, and forward the argument at each hop.
Constraints: Unity Catalog's registry accepts order_by but ignores it (its docstring says it is not used), and the fluent docstring notes "Not honored by Unity Catalog registries". Do not assume order_by sorts results on UC.
applies: Adding or changing arguments on prompt search across store, client, fluent and genai APIs.
says: The prompt catalog search does not let us sort prompt templates by date.
We need an option to sort prompt search results in the prompt registry.
Prompt search sorting order is ignored when viewing prompts in Unity Catalog.
Add sorting controls to the prompt search bar so users can order results.
Filtering prompts works but ordering search results by updated time fails.
search: Prompt search requires any new or changed parameter to be exposed and forwarded across four layers: RegistryClient.search_prompts or AbstractStore.search_prompts, MlflowClient.search_prompts, _model_registry.fluent.search_prompts, and mlflow.genai.prompts.search_prompts. When adding search options such as order_by, update signatures and docstrings at all four hops. Unity Catalog registries accept order_by in their docstrings but ignore it and do not sort results.
